ideas.idea: Add concrete pricing tiers and prices as HTML text on /pricing
ideas.why: The page only says 'Talk to us for a quote', so there is nothing for people or answer engines to read or quote.
JSON-LD is not required here, and it adds little without real pricing content.

ideas.idea: Add Disallow groups for the other training crawlers (ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot and others)
ideas.why: geo.config.json says to block training crawlers, but robots.txt only blocks GPTBot.

ideas.idea: Add explicit Allow groups for search and retrieval crawlers
ideas.why: These crawlers are already allowed by the * group, so the groups only guard against future changes.

ideas.idea: Add viewport, Open Graph and Twitter meta defaults in root meta
ideas.why: This is standard advice for any site, and it has little effect on search or AI discovery.

ideas.idea: Add Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication and FAQPage JSON-LD
ideas.why: Having no JSON-LD is not a required fix, and FAQPage markup is pushed even though no FAQ exists.

ideas.idea: Add Features and Home links to the root nav
ideas.why: The nav only links Pricing and Changelog, so real links in the nav would give crawlers and users a path to /features.

ideas.idea: Replace the vague 'Integrates with all the tools' claim with named integrations
ideas.why: The home page claim names nothing, so there is nothing specific to cite or understand.

ideas.idea: Expand /features with an h2 and a short description for each feature
ideas.why: The page is a single sentence under the h1, so it has almost nothing to read or cite.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod to sitemap entries and generate the sitemap from routes
ideas.why: This is a common sitemap improvement with a small effect on a four-URL site.

ideas.idea: Remove the /dashboard Disallow and rely on noindex alone
ideas.why: The Disallow and noindex on a private page are a deliberate choice, and removing the Disallow would let crawlers fetch it.
A missing llms.txt is not a problem, and the file is not a way to be found.
